about_the_game:
- UNDER WORLD -

"UNDER WORLD" is a deck-building roguelite set in a post-war, devastated underground world. Build a unique deck by combining cards and items, defeat enemies, and delve deeper into the underground.

- Game Features -

  • A dungeon that changes with every playthrough
    The dungeon automatically takes on a random shape, with different enemies, cards, and events appearing each time, offering a new experience on every run!

  • Massive content
    With over 250 cards, 150 items, and 50 enemies, a vast amount of content awaits you.

  • Various events
    Many events occur along the way, forcing players to make choices. Your choices affect your "Morality" and "Soul," influencing future rewards and events.

  • Content unlocking
    By playing repeatedly and earning points, you can unlock new cards, items, and more. Incorporating these unlocked elements into your deck creates new synergies to explore.

- Playtime -

We offer a rich and satisfying experience. Each playthrough is expected to take over an hour.

- Video Upload & Streaming Guidelines -

Please follow these guidelines when uploading videos or streaming this game:

  • Videos and streams containing content that violates public order and morals or significantly damages the game's value or world are prohibited.

  • Please include "UNDER WORLD" in the title of your videos and streams.

  • Please include the URL of the store page in the description of your videos and streams.

  • Commercial or profit-making use is prohibited. However, you may use the monetization features officially provided to contributors by YouTube and other video sharing sites.

  • Our company bears no responsibility for any damages incurred by publishers or third parties as a result of videos and streams.

  • These guidelines may be changed without prior notice.
